title: Understanding Age Data
text: Consider how age data can be used in a linear model. Think about transformations or normalizations that might be applied to age data to make it more suitable for modeling.

title: Transformations of Age Data
text: Age data can be used in its raw form, but sometimes transformations like scaling or normalizing can help improve model performance. Consider if these transformations are applicable.

title: Scaling Age Data
text: One way to use age data is to scale it. For example, you could divide each age by the maximum age in the dataset to get a value between $$0$$ and $$1$$. Is this a reasonable approach?

title: Normalizing Age Data
text: Another approach is to normalize the age data. This could involve subtracting the mean age and dividing by the standard deviation. Would this method correctly capture the meaning of age?

title: Using Age Data Directly
text: Consider using the age data directly without any transformation. Is this a reasonable way to use age data in the model?
